questions.text: What does CTC training do when the transcript is known but the frame-to-token alignment is not?

options.A: Assign each transcript token to an equally sized audio segment.
options.B: Sum the probabilities of alignments that collapse to the transcript.
options.C: Train only on the single alignment chosen by framewise argmax.
options.D: Require manually annotated token boundaries before computing loss.

questions.explanation: CTC marginalizes over valid frame-level alignments, including blanks and repeats, whose collapse yields the target transcript.

questions.text: An ASR system makes 2 substitutions, 1 deletion, and 3 insertions against a 20-word reference. What is its word error rate?
The greedy CTC decoder appends p when p != prev and p != blank, then always sets prev = p. With blank represented by _, what does a a _ a b b _ collapse to?
questions.explanation: Adjacent repeated a values merge, but a blank resets prev and separates the second a; adjacent b values merge and blanks are omitted.
